ScientificClaim.claimText: 1,445 mRNAs were identified as significantly differentially expressed between breast cancer and adjacent non-cancerous breast tissue samples, and 20 of these candidates showed diagnostic performance with an area under the ROC curve (AUC) greater than 0.9 when distinguishing breast cancer from non-cancerous tissue.

RationaleArtifact.rationaleText: The evidence identifies a large number of mRNAs that are significantly differentially expressed between breast cancer and non-cancerous tissue, and further analysis shows that 20 of these candidates have strong diagnostic performance in distinguishing between the two groups.
RationaleArtifact.keyEvidenceSummary: 1,445 mRNAs were identified as significantly differentially expressed (EI-CS1-01) and 20 of these candidates showed strong diagnostic performance (AUC > 0.9, EI-CS1-02).
uncertainties: The findings are based on a single study and may not be generalizable to other populations or datasets.
The diagnostic performance of the identified mRNAs needs further validation in independent datasets.
